newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Sanacorp plans autumn bourse listing.
newsitem.headline: German Sanacorp plans autumn bourse listing.

text.p: German pharmaceuticals company Sanacorp Pharmahandel AG said on Thursday it planned to sell shares on the bourse for the first time during the autumn.
More details would be released at a press conference on October 14, the company said in a statement.
The company confirmed that DG Bank would lead the banking consortium managing the issue.
Other banks involved would be Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Bayerische Landesbank Girozentrale, Bayerische Vereinsbank AG and the Deutsche Apotheker und Aerztebank.
Sanacorp said the shares would be listed in Frankfurt and would be broadly distributed.
The company said it had achieved sales of more than 3.5 billion marks in the year ended June 30 and a significant jump in earnings.
Proceeds of the share issue would be used to strengthen and expand its competitive and output capacity.
